DRAFT — L3 Mature_B_core depth/PTPRC-matched spatial null

Six fixed L3 samples; descriptive spatial QC; pending manual review

DRAFT — pending manual review

This report is a descriptive spatial-QC analysis. It is not a disease comparison and does not call a B-cell niche, aggregate, TLS or hotspot. Rendering does not approve the interpretation.

Executive summary

All six fixed L3 samples were retained without expression-based selection. SSC/05957/17B remains explicitly marked as an extremely low-capture sample. The analysis read the previously persisted strict_same_bin and strict_rook flags; it did not reconstruct a score, modify a marker or threshold, or inspect a new raw-count object.

For IPF/FO23-1-06168, the clustering-direction percentile was at least 100.0% for all four same-bin spatial metrics and 100.0% for all four rook metrics after exact depth/n_genes/PTPRC matching. Its same-bin largest component contained 10, 0.7567568, 28, 50 of 37, 37, 37, 37 supported Bins, versus a matched-null median of 35, 0.0540541, 2, 158.113883.

For SSC/15491/14, the corresponding minimum percentiles were 100.0% for same-bin and 100.0% for rook. Its same-bin largest component contained 36, 0.4461538, 29, 70.7106781 of 65, 65, 65, 65 supported Bins, versus a matched-null median of 62, 0.0307692, 2, 158.113883.

Thus matching the local sequencing-depth, gene-complexity and PTPRC background did not remove the focal clustering signal in either prespecified focus sample. Under the preregistered interpretation rule, both remain depth-adjusted focal B-lineage candidates for manual spatial review. This does not establish a B-cell niche, aggregate, TLS or disease difference.

The unmatched and matched nulls led to the same descriptive conclusion for both focus samples. Matching moved the null distributions toward greater clustering in several metrics, as expected, but the observed focus-sample values remained at or beyond the clustering-direction maximum of all 1,000 matched draws.

Important limitation: strict rook support is itself defined using rook adjacency. Its strong connectivity is therefore partly structural and must not be treated as independent biological evidence. The same-bin result is the less circular spatial diagnostic, and the six same-chip samples provide the relevant background context. Empirical percentiles in this report are descriptive ranks, not P values.

The fixed matching layer for each tissue Bin was the cross-classification of sample-specific empirical quintiles of log1p(total_counts), empirical quintiles of n_genes, and PTPRC raw-positive versus raw-zero status. Average ranks kept ties together. Each matched draw sampled without replacement and reproduced the observed stratum counts exactly.

Spatial null results across all six samples

For largest-component size and fraction, larger values indicate stronger clustering. For component number and median nearest-neighbor distance, smaller values indicate stronger clustering. The “clustering-direction percentile” reverses the latter two so that higher always means more clustered than the null.

The full Bin-to-stratum assignment and all 96,000 null metric rows are provided as compressed TSV files in tables/.

Interpretation boundary

  • Marker co-capture and its spatial clustering do not measure actual B-cell area.
  • The focus-sample same-bin signal remains more clustered than randomized Bins with the same local depth, complexity and PTPRC status; it is therefore retained only as a depth-adjusted focal B-lineage candidate.
  • Rook support is adjacency-derived and is supporting visualization/QC, not an independent spatial test.
  • No disease inference is made from six same-chip samples.
  • No B-cell niche, aggregate, TLS, hotspot or Moran’s I result is reported.
  • No marker selection, threshold optimization, rescoring, clustering, cell2location or NMF was performed.

Reproducibility

The fixed random seed was 260824; each null used 1000 draws. The exact analysis command was:

Rscript scripts/397_l3_mature_b_depth_ptprc_matched_spatial_null.R --timestamp=260823211809

This report was rendered only after the persisted support flags, fixed sample membership, null-row count and every matched draw passed validation.
